CA.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is explicitly linked to an origin entry indicating a processing condition (command_estimate) for the same referent.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate sets) is explicitly identified, accompanied by an origin/organization field and thus a separate status/organization entry for the same referent.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('kind":"command_estimate') is explicitly associated with the same referent's organization/origin entry.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (color 'red') and its attribute (a specific coordinate set) for a named referent.

D.rationale: The content coordinates and a separate origin/organization/status field are both present for the same referent, distinguishing content from its organization/status.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/organization entry describes how the content instance is represented/organized (e.g. 'feedback_through', 'kind').
